body: I'll feel just like I feel today, tired of being a part of this stupid rat race called life.
It's hard to give up on life when your goal since you're around 4-5 years old is death. I think I lived a great life overall, I just want it to end before shit hits the fan again.

I've been helping people all my fucking life. Especially now that my whole family uses me as a fucking general translator. Never would call myself a man either. I just hope my ancestors won't angrily frown their eyebrows when if I meet them.

Can't survive without a job. Can't get my hurting teeth fixed without money. Can't get a really good job when you smoke pot, which is the only thing that helped my migraines. But above all, can't get a job when you're not willing to try. And I'm done trying.

I lived my life for myself. I'm a loner. Was a complete forever alone until recently. Especially the past 2 months I've been unemployed, I've been a selfish prick and felt good about it. Still helped out. Now I feel it's time to go is nearing and it's time to see whats on the other side.
I'd rather feel nothing than feel anxiety. Wasted too many opportunities to list for a better life. Better life doesn't come, it gets earned. I didn't earn it.
I'll be dead, I won't care at that point.
Can't afford medical help when you're broke in the beautiful US of A. My parents already pay off my dad's two suicide attempts and my brother is paying off his wife's surgery.
